description: This file defines the SampleDataLoader class which implements CommandLineRunner to seed sample data into the database at application startup. It injects NoteService and calls seedSampleData() to initialize sample notes.

classes.name: SampleDataLoader
classes.description: A Spring component that loads sample notes data into the database on startup.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executed at application startup to seed sample data if the database is empty.
